game.title: SOLARWAKE
game.subtitle: Solar Ring Pursuit
game.tagline: Ride the solar wake through a shattered ring and silence the machine consuming it.
boss.name: BOREWARDEN
boss.title: Rogue deep-core mining platform
boss.phase2.sub: The drill is open. Hit the core!
boss.phase3.sub: Its heart is exposed. Finish it!
stage.title: Stage 1 · The Shattered Ring
stage.sub: Clear the belt. Find what is devouring it.
stage.ring.name: The Shattered Ring
stage.ring.desc: Gas-giant ring belt · asteroid storm · the BOREWARDEN colossus
stage.orbit.name: Earth Orbit
stage.orbit.desc: Kessler debris · atmospheric skip · orbital blockade
stage2.title: Stage 2 · Earth Orbit
stage2.sub: Home is below. The machines are dropping out of the sky — cut them down.
wave1.title: Wave 1 · Scout Swarm
wave1.sub: Chain kills to raise the multiplier
storm.title: Asteroid Storm
storm.sub: Full throttle. Shoot through or slip past!
wave2.title: Wave 2 · Hunter Wing
warning.title: Warning
kessler.title: Kessler Cascade
kessler.sub: Debris field ahead. Full burn and weave!
skip.title: Atmospheric Skip
skip.sub: Graze the upper atmosphere — the burn keeps the lane clear
blockade.title: Orbital Blockade
blockade.sub: They have massed above the terminator
finale.title: Break the Blockade
finale.sub: No reinforcements left. Empty the sky.
breakout.title: Orbital Breakout
breakout.sub: You are through. Welcome home, pilot
cue.orbit: Hostiles in the lane — clear a path
cue.atmo: Hull is heating: hold the skim and keep firing
hint.move.keyboard: {mouse} Aim and steer · or {keys} to fly
hint.move.touch: Drag the left pad to fly
hint.fire.touch: Hold FIRE. The reticle locks on by itself
hint.roll.touch: Tap ROLL to spin through bullets
controls.title: Flight Controls
pause.title: Paused
settings.title: Settings
leaderboard.title: Leaderboard

results.name: Pilot callsign
results.title: Title
credits.fonts: Original game · Fonts: Sora, Figtree, Noto Sans SC (SIL OFL)
results.tuned: Tuned run — not eligible for leaderboard
stage.loop.name: Continuous Loop
stage.loop.desc: A glass ribbon in zero gravity · no end, only the drift
stage3.title: CONTINUOUS LOOP
stage3.sub: No target. No end. Just the ribbon.
loop.cycle.title: THE DRIFT CONTINUES
loop.cycle.sub: Fly the ribbon as long as you like — the loop never closes early.
cue.ribbon: Hold the lane — the ribbon is the whole sky
cue.drift: Squadron drifting in — pick them off slowly
cue.sentinel: Sentinel ahead: it fires in rhythms, not bursts
hangar.title: Hangar
weapon.pulse.name: Pulse Driver
weapon.pulse.desc: Twin-linked bolts. Reliable, cheap to master and the trigger you already own.
weapon.scatter.name: Scatter Cloud
weapon.scatter.desc: A wide cone of hot pellets: it shreds anything close and reaches nothing far.
weapon.lance.name: Lance Beam
weapon.lance.desc: A thin needle that punches clean through a line of hulls before it fades.
weapon.swarm.name: Swarm Pods
weapon.swarm.desc: Seeker volleys that curve after the nearest hostile. Light hits, few misses.
weapon.rail.name: Rail Slug
weapon.rail.desc: One charged slug per pull and a blast around the impact. Slow and heavy.
ship.heliospur.name: Heliospur
ship.heliospur.desc: The line interceptor: balanced hull, balanced guns, the one you already fly.
ship.vesper.name: Vesper
ship.vesper.desc: Featherweight racer: the fastest hull on the roster and paper-thin armour.
ship.bastion.name: Bastion
ship.bastion.desc: Heavy line hull with nearly twice the armour and the turning circle to match.
ship.kite.name: Kite
ship.kite.desc: Delta-wing skirmisher: a huge shield and a wide graze ring, built to live close to bullets.
cue.shard: Prism shards — break one and it splits in two
